all_questions.definition: all original questions and three held-generation records
all_questions.conditional_weight_note: Pooled row weights selected records; task50_50 computes each task's own conditional mean then equal-weights, provided both have support

two_seed_any_mean_value_gap.definition: two nonheld seeds have nonconstant actionwise reward sums
two_seed_any_mean_value_gap.conditional_weight_note: Pooled row weights selected records; task50_50 computes each task's own conditional mean then equal-weights, provided both have support

two_seed_stable_action_pair.definition: some action pair has the same nonzero reward difference in both nonheld seeds
two_seed_stable_action_pair.conditional_weight_note: Pooled row weights selected records; task50_50 computes each task's own conditional mean then equal-weights, provided both have support

two_seed_stable_selected_pair.definition: M4 minus Ridge is the same nonzero sign in both nonheld seeds
two_seed_stable_selected_pair.conditional_weight_note: Pooled row weights selected records; task50_50 computes each task's own conditional mean then equal-weights, provided both have support

two_seed_selected_M4_ahead.definition: M4 minus Ridge equals +1 in both nonheld seeds
two_seed_selected_M4_ahead.conditional_weight_note: Pooled row weights selected records; task50_50 computes each task's own conditional mean then equal-weights, provided both have support

two_seed_selected_Ridge_ahead.definition: M4 minus Ridge equals -1 in both nonheld seeds
two_seed_selected_Ridge_ahead.conditional_weight_note: Pooled row weights selected records; task50_50 computes each task's own conditional mean then equal-weights, provided both have support

two_seed_default_repair_opportunity.definition: global default fails in both nonheld seeds and some one combination succeeds in both
two_seed_default_repair_opportunity.conditional_weight_note: Pooled row weights selected records; task50_50 computes each task's own conditional mean then equal-weights, provided both have support

three_seed_any_mean_gap.definition: three-seed actionwise mean range is nonzero
three_seed_any_mean_gap.scope: Posthoc outcome-defined stratum, selected and evaluated on the same three repeats

three_seed_nonzero_selected_mean_gap.definition: three-seed M4 minus Ridge mean is nonzero
three_seed_nonzero_selected_mean_gap.scope: Posthoc outcome-defined stratum, selected and evaluated on the same three repeats

three_seed_selected_consistent_nonzero.definition: M4 minus Ridge has one strict sign in all three generations
three_seed_selected_consistent_nonzero.scope: Posthoc outcome-defined stratum, selected and evaluated on the same three repeats

three_seed_stable_action_pair.definition: some action pair has one strict sign in all three generations
three_seed_stable_action_pair.scope: Posthoc outcome-defined stratum, selected and evaluated on the same three repeats

limitations: Each fixed router was trained using other questions and all three historical repeats; only stratum definition excludes its own held generation
LOSO strata use same-question reward feedback unavailable to an input-only router
Three-repeat consistency is empirical, not a precise conditional expectation or population stability guarantee
Question bootstrap retains all generation and LOSO dependence but conditions on reused-development folds with overlapping training histories
All strata are exploratory and cannot certify a selected new router or unique failure mechanism
